# The Coin Wire

> Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and protocol upgrades: what changed, and what comes next.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://cryptoworldtoday.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://cryptoworldtoday.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://cryptoworldtoday.github.io/archive/): everything published.
